metadata.title: A constructive solution to Talagrand's Gaussian convexification problem
metadata.abstract: Talagrand asked for an explicit construction of a large convex subset of a bounded Minkowski sum of a large Gaussian set. Let $A\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ be closed with $\gamma_n(A)\ge 7/8$. We prove that for every $\lambda>4$ and every $4\le t<\lambda$, one can construct a finite polyhedron $C\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ such that \[ C\subset \lambda(A+A+A) \qquad\text{and}\qquad \gamma_n(C)\ge 1-\frac1t. \] The construction is finite-dimensional: a separation argument produces polyhedral convex barriers, Gaussian integrability yields a uniform slope bound, and a finite net reduces the global problem to a finite convex minimization problem. As an application, we give a finite semidefinite construction of an optimal-scale ellipsoid. There is a universal constant $c>0$ such that, for $n\ge2$, one can construct an ellipsoid $E$ satisfying \[ \gamma_n(E)\ge\frac12 \qquad\text{and}\qquad c\sqrt{\frac{\log n}{n}}\,E\subset \lambda(A+A+A). \] The same finite-barrier method also yields a constructive bounded-step convexification result for balanced Gaussian sets.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 为 Talagrand 高斯凸化给出有限多面体的构造性版本，并讨论椭球近似的优化常数。
analysis.breakthrough: 在指定测度和缩放范围内获得显式多面体包含及高斯测度界，并刻画椭球常数的量级。
analysis.limitations: 构造性不自动等于多项式时间高效；测度阈值、参数范围及平衡变体不能混用。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 高维凸几何中的有限化及定量估计工具复用价值较高。
